scope: Unique57 physical poses, each selected earliest valid history or its one new execution; counts overlap and do not imply uniquely isolated causes.
boundary: A qualifying pickup step uses the original5mm reference-rise transient criterion; final success requires50mm.
No hold phase means reference rise is unobserved, not a numeric low-rise measurement.
A gate failure or insufficient final rise does not imply absence of contact.
Any finger contact uses summed original object finger loads>1mN; bilateral requires thumb and opposing sum each>1mN.
This is trace diagnostics under coarse proxies and controlled wrist, not proof of one root cause.
